method: Each pair is the recipe as placed (full) against its greybox stand-in or against the base without the detail shells (bare); side by hash coin. Reads were written from the contact sheets before pairs/key.json was opened (sheet_<recipe>.png).

reads.cenote_pool__close__full-vs-grey: left is the recipe: a sandstone sinkhole with a teal pool, ledge roof and copper-ringed stalactites; right is a flat grey slab
reads.cenote_pool__mid__full-vs-grey: left is the recipe; right is the grey block seen from inside
reads.cenote_pool__far__full-vs-grey: left is the grey block; right is the recipe
reads.cenote_pool__close__full-vs-bare: right has more rocks on the floor edge: right is full
reads.flooded_shaft__close__full-vs-grey: left is grey; right is the recipe, a timbered drift
reads.flooded_shaft__mid__full-vs-grey: left is grey; right is the recipe
reads.flooded_shaft__far__full-vs-grey: left is the recipe; right is the grey block
reads.flooded_shaft__close__full-vs-bare: left has extra rock spikes at the wall foot: left is full
reads.cavern_shell__close__full-vs-grey: left is grey; right is the recipe, a strata gallery with a far pool
reads.cavern_shell__mid__full-vs-grey: left is grey; right is the recipe
reads.cavern_shell__far__full-vs-grey: left is the recipe; right is the grey block
reads.cavern_shell__close__full-vs-bare: left has more boulders: left is full

misses: Pool shoreline reads as stepped cells at close (0.75 m water cells), not a smooth edge.
Water is an opaque flat teal (glass slot at its default frosted value), so it reads as paint, not water; the stage sets the instance uniform or a water shader.
The shells' roofs are one-sided: from outside (mid and far) the roof vanishes and timbers float, by design under terrain, but a hole edge will show the void.
The detail shells do not read at mid range: all three full-vs-bare mid pairs were undecidable.
Anchor copper eyes are readable at close only; at mid they are red specks.
The cenote's ledge roof reads as a thin brown plank from below; the shell has no thickness.
